sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; PVDetector was selected after top two candidates were confirmed duplicates on latest data.
Read arXiv abstract, HTML full text, method sections, tables, appendices, and official GitHub README.
Extracted PV vector formulas, PVS score, key-layer selection, benchmark setup, main results, ablations, VLM tests, and code availability boundary.
Documented hidden-state access requirement, threshold calibration risk, adaptive attack boundary, and incomplete repository release.
Searched external coverage and used arXiv plus official repository because independent third-party analysis was not yet available.
Produced pure Markdown with TL;DR, tables, formulas, pseudocode, Mermaid, figure/table evidence, and Chinese length over 5000.
